body: The wound is bound to your identity and body; you may feel marked, awkward in your own skin, or 'too much / not enough' as a person.
business: People trust you because your self-acceptance was earned, not handed to you.
shadow: Defining yourself by the injury, or armoring up so no one sees it.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
